text: Pellet, ooñotooɓe ɓen e Aayeeje Amen Alla ɗen, ɓe yedda ɗe ɓe fenna, ɓe wayla ɗe, fii maɓɓe suuɗaaki Men; Meɗen anndi fii maɓɓe. E ko feroyteeɗo on ka Yiite ɓuri moƴƴude kaa ko aroyoowo on Ñalnde Darngal himo hoolii daɗugol lepte? Onon ɓee yiimɓe, huuwee ko yiɗuɗon e moƴƴere maa bone, Men ɓannginanii on ɗate moƴƴere e bone ɗen fow. Ko pellet, Allah no reeni ko golloton e ɗin kon. Hunnde e kuuɗe mon, suuɗaaki Mo.
